comment: Limits for tests/perf/run-resource-audit.py on the router emulator: processes (execs) and file operations on USB (opt_ops) per run; daemons per minute at one DNS query per second (a short window sees more first-time names, which are logged). Measured values of 0.2.0-rc.2 (resource contour: shell builtins, one clock read, lighter admission) plus headroom (daemons vary with the names seen in the window; the supervisor may log one event, such as PANEL_START_FAILED, inside it). fix.33.2: jobs by the median of 5 runs with crond paused, daemons by the quieter of two windows; the updater check and housekeeping vary by 3 processes from run to run on unchanged code (57-62 and 25-28 on fix.33.1 and fix.33.2, the lock and the hour they meet), so their limits are 3 above the measured median.
